title: We are the Boys from Cherry
transcription:
We are the boys from Cherry

We are the boys from Cherry
That you've heard so much about.
The people stop and stare at us
Whenever we go out.
We aren't a bit stuck up,
And we always have a laugh. (Ha ha)
We are the boys, we are the boys
From good old Cherry staff.
As we go marching
And the band begins to P L A Y
You can hear us shouting,
The Cherry Valley Staff is on their way.
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription from photographed page spread. Nonsense syllables in 'Hucka' are especially uncertain.
